verdict.rationale: Gemini API keeps a standing deprecations page. Deprecations are announced in the release notes, and the page tracks the earliest shutdown date for each model, so developers get dated advance notice. Versioned model IDs stay pinnable while `-latest` aliases move. However, the evidence shows no explicit migration guidance and no guaranteed minimum notice period. missing for 10: documented migration guidance or recommended replacement models, a stated minimum notice window, independent corroboration that notices arrive in advance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired

citations.quote: Deprecation announcements are made on the Release notes page, and the announced earliest shutdown dates are tracked on this page. Already-shutdown models are indicated
`-latest` aliases move on release while versioned model IDs stay pinnable
